name: whose-top
what: A held day is decided at the flow that holds (ADR 0026 §6): at the top, where the estate only waits, the day's Decide button says where the decision is made

name: whose-sheet
what: The decision sheet says whose it is before anything else: the flow whose file holds, what of it holds, and the flow that waits on it

.vf-detail .vf-whose: Evidence feeds’ to decide: access_reviews holds. Larkspur estate waits on it.

name: whose-inside
what: Inside the flow that holds, the button is its own: Decide

name: whose-flow-sheet
what: The flow that holds has Decide on its sheet, beside the way into it; the sheet it opens is the same decision

.vf-detail .vf-whose: Evidence feeds’ to decide: access_reviews holds.

name: whose-decided
what: The day decided at Evidence feeds: one choice, recorded as the file's decision, Evidence feeds', and the posture's own load carrying it; the record says whose each was, and no release is refused

name: whose-recorded
what: A day the story decided: the empty EDR file was Evidence feeds' to decide, and the day's story, opened, says where it was decided

name: whose-month
what: The month's day picked says the same in its timeline: at Evidence feeds, who filled it and from which day

name: whose-dark
what: The sheet's head in the dark scheme, in a fresh browser where the day waits again
